arm_note: strata 'arm' column is a clinical diagnosis; the archetype arm is A_all9 (arch_w0..4). A_all9 chosen as primary: its dominant-name labels match strata.arch_dominant_name exactly, and it has complete 8-axis profiles (B_specifics has NaN overall_severity).

definitions.r2: 1 - SS_res/SS_tot, SS_tot about each axis mean; per-axis or pooled(variance-weighted) for OVERALL.
definitions.var_retained_frac: Var(Xhat_axis)/Var(X_axis); OVERALL = sum Var(Xhat)/sum Var(X) over 8 axes.
definitions.rmse: per-axis sqrt(mean((x-xhat)^2)); OVERALL pooled over all cells.
definitions.per_patient_error_sd: sqrt(mean_axis(((x-xhat)/SD_axis)^2)) — cross-axis RMSE in per-axis population-SD units.
definitions.reconstruction: x_hat_i = sum_a w_ia * z_a  (X ≈ W Z, convex/archetypal).

best_axis_note: immunometabolic highest R2 (well-separated corners strongly load this axis).
worst_axis_note: substance lowest R2: its profile values are ~0 across all 5 corners (range -0.120..0.113), so the blend carries almost no info on it; cognition is similarly weakly separated.
entropy_error_direction: negative — fog (high-entropy) patients reconstruct slightly better; interior blends lie inside the corner hull whereas near-corner patients include hull-exceeding extremes.
population_entropy_note: most patients have entropy 0.6-1.0 (of max ln5=1.609): a fog-heavy, continuum-like population; few patients pin to a single corner.
notes: Archetypes trade fidelity for interpretability+convexity: they recover 59.0% of pooled coordinate variance vs 79.6% for the 5-PC linear optimum (gap 20.6pp; vs the fair 4-affine-dim PCA4=68.0%, gap 9.1pp), and far exceed a 5-centroid hard partition (32.5%). No per-patient raw clinical values written.
